title: feat: show managed agent tool calls
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds Open WebUI-compatible tool execution blocks to managed-agent responses.
- Includes tool IDs, names, parameters, outputs, and failures without exposing inline binary media.
- Uses the same renderer for streaming and non-streaming responses while preserving generated media links.
- Covers both response modes and the tool-error path.

Checks:
- `npx tsc --noEmit`
- `npx vitest run test/prompt-agent-runtime.test.ts` (19 passed)
- `npx biome check --write src/services/prompt-agent-runtime.ts test/prompt-agent-runtime.test.ts`
- `npm run build:frontend`

gist.headline: Agents show their work
gist.blurb: Managed agents now leave tidy little tool-call receipts behind. You can see what they reached for, what came back, and when a tool had a bad day.
gist.summary: Managed-agent responses now include Open WebUI-compatible tool execution blocks with tool IDs, names, parameters, outputs, and failures in both streaming and non-streaming modes, while keeping generated media links intact and binary media out of inline responses.
gist.impact: People integrating managed agents can now inspect each tool call and error consistently as a response arrives or after it completes, making agent runs much easier to follow and debug.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy managed-agent workbench where Polli acts as an observant mechanic, organizing small labeled tool-call cards from a retro terminal: tool name, parameters, output, and a tiny harmless error card. A CRT monitor robot eagerly displays the same neat execution trail, while generated-media links appear as glowing picture postcards rather than bulky binary files; code-plants and flowers make the runtime feel alive.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-dark-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny tool belt, carefully pinning neat tool-call cards labeled "TOOL", "PARAMS", "OUTPUT", and "ERROR" beside a glowing retro terminal. A cheerful CRT monitor robot displays a matching execution trail and small glowing media-link postcards, surrounded by code-plants and flowers on a prominent lime green (#ecf874) and warm cream pastel background; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
